description: Download payroll CSVs and upload payslip PDFs to Google Drive

scripts.name: drive_download
scripts.description: Download the latest payroll CSV from the period folder in Google Drive

args.name: dest
args.description: Local destination path for the downloaded CSV

scripts.name: drive_upload
scripts.description: Upload per-employee payslip PDFs and CSVs from payslip/output/ to Google Drive

args.name: source
args.description: Local directory containing per-employee payslip output

scripts.name: drive_quarantine
scripts.description: Find payslip objects misplaced in one Drive period folder and write a dry-run report; --execute moves the reported objects to a quarantine folder beside the payslips root (live Drive; never deletes)

args.name: period
args.description: Period folder to test, YYYY-MM (dry run only; read from the report under --execute)

args.name: report
args.description: Dry-run report path: written by the dry run (never overwritten), read by --execute

args.name: execute
args.description: Move exactly the pairs a reviewed dry-run report names; refuses a report already executed
